office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Jill Klinge is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge appointed in 2019 and retained in 2020 and 2022, sitting at the Bellevue Courthouse, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: One of two full-time judges at the Bellevue Courthouse [S1]
Statement describes balancing accountability and community safety with opportunities for defendants committed to change [S1]
